It offered to send a senior-most officer to receive the memorandum, but the MPs declined. The explanation may address the question of procedure. The concern went beyond accuracy. The ease of producing polished-looking work was beginning to raise questions about whether the thinking behind it was becoming weaker. Much of the early discussion around generative AI focused on capability, particularly what it could draft, summarise or automate. items.title: ‘Dress is a personal choice’: Kerala HC backs woman’s right to wear what she chooses
items.summary: The Kerala High Court has declared that a citizen’s choice of attire is a matter of personal choice and that nobody can dictate what a person should wear based on social customs or personal notions of what is appropriate. Justice PV Kunhikrishnan made the observation while disposing of a petition filed by Sindhu S Nair, Headmistress of Eeswara Vilasom High School, Kottarakkara, against Suresh Kumar, the school manager. Sindhu had alleged that the manager prevented her from entering the school because she was wearing a churidar instead of a saree. The court noted that the dispute, at first glance, appeared to concern a simple question of attire. However, it said the issue had a deeper constitutional and institutional significance as it involved “the dignity, autonomy and professional standing of an educated woman” and the limits of managerial authority over her personal choice of dress. According to Sindhu’s petition, Suresh entered her office on February 3, 2026 and allegedly told her that she should not wear a churidar to school. She further alleged that he called security personnel in her presence and instructed them not to allow her into the school if she came wearing a churidar
